title: Grateful Dead Live at Olympic Center on 1983-10-17
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M > Cassette Master (Sony WM-D6 Patched)

ai_review.summary: Good audience‑sourced recording captures a nice set highlighted by TLMD and an atmospheric crowd mix.
ai_review.review: The audience‑level recording is well balanced, giving the show a pleasant live feel. Reviewers describe the set as "nice" and especially enjoy the moments when TLMD appears, indicating a solid musical performance despite the lack of detailed commentary on individual playing.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4‑star) praising both the set and the audience mix; limited data leads to a modest rating with low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience background level is noted as adding atmosphere, suggesting a clear enough mix without major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall described as a nice set; reviewers appreciate the flow especially when TLMD is performed.
